name: dsh-agent-connector
//name: The npm name is dsh-agent-connector (the user, 2026-11-17: dsh-connector is taken on npm by an unrelated package). Only the package name changed: the folder stays packages/dsh-connector, and the row id dsh-connector, its settings namespace and every /api/agent/* and /api/dsh-connector/* path are code constants and stay as they are. The profile row's `name` is the package specifier DSH loads, so cordis.patch.yml names the new package.
//version: The package version is the release's, shared by every V3 package (REL-PACK, requirements Q-G10: 1.0.0-alpha.1).
description: Exposes this DeepSeek Harness to the agents that manage its sessions, over MCP with OAuth: sessions, permission requests, questions, plan reviews, prompts and grants route session → its managing agent → the user.
//exports: ./mcp-schema (tool and event schemas, limits, vocabularies) and ./tools (contribution types, apiVersion, defineTool) are V3's data-and-types modules (design §9.1), frozen by the V3-K tasks K1 and K2. ./client is the connector's own settings page (design §5.9). C-WIRE-2 removed ./contract (the V2 contract) with the V2 broker; ./records moved to dsh-connector-ui with the UI (R-EMBED).
//locale: The Plugins page card title (design §0.7): DSH reads meta.title from the exported ./locale/*.json without loading this package, and shows the package name when that file is absent. The connector's browser code is client.js, served through dsh.client and ./client: its own settings page (R-ARCH-03 amended by 1.28, design §5.9) and the marks part with Hand over / Take back (client.marks.js, DESIGN.md §28); dsh-connector-ui owns the rest of the UI (the Fishball sidebar row, window, light and notify prompt).
//engines: node >=22.14: C-EXT resolves a contributor's package with node:module findPackageJSON (22.14 / 23.2); DSH itself needs >=24.9.0 on both SDKs (Fishball 2026-11-14; REL-PACK aligns engines across packages). The connector requires dsh-web-app in the profile (the user, 2026-11-17, S1 = A): its MCP endpoint and OAuth routes are served on DSH's web server, and the row injects web-app services (connection, sessionController, workspaceRegistry), so without the web app the row stays pending in DSH's own missing-dependency state.
//dependencies: Fishball owns the MCP server: both supported hosts provide a client, not a server. Node 2.1.2 requires server ^2.4.0; pin the pair exactly (K1 SDK_PINS). The HTTP endpoint uses toNodeHandler, not serveStatic. hono satisfies the HTTP adapter stack in DSH's hoisted pnpm profiles with autoInstallPeers disabled. dsh-connector-adapter, dsh-connector-watchdog and @modelcontextprotocol/client ship bundled with dsh-agent-connector so installing the connector bundle brings the amenities along (the user, 2026-11-23).
//bundleDependencies: dsh-connector-shared (R-ARCH-08, the DSH side's library), the two amenities (dsh-connector-adapter, dsh-connector-watchdog) and the adapter's @modelcontextprotocol/client closure are bundled so the tarball carries them and an install (online or offline) fetches none of them from a registry.
//peerDependencies: Host packages are resolved from the running DSH installation (verified in spike S8). '*' because engines.dsh is the real compatibility gate.

dsh.//client: One client entry (design §5.9; C-WIRE mounts C-TOKENS-REVEAL's client.js): the connector's own settings page in the Plugins page's plugins.row.config slot, the marks part (client.marks.js: Hand over / Take back, Managed by, the managed row mark; moved from dsh-connector-ui by DESIGN.md §28), and the browser helpers over the connector UI backend, exported as ui. inject covers the services both use: the renderer's slots, locale, the settings and plugin-manager pages, and the providers of the marks' slots (conversation header, workspace session rows and menu, layout's shell.overlay), as dsh-connector-ui's manifest listed them for the marks.
